support.purpose: background/support geometry whose read is mostly silhouette and mass at official cameras
support.geometry_policy: use the lowest triangle budget that preserves official zoom 19/12/9 readability
support.material_policy: reuse canonical Eldoria material families; avoid unique material sets
support.lod_policy: optional; only if measured benefit on target mobile

primary.purpose: important playable buildings such as Aserradero and Cuartel
primary.geometry_policy: preserve functional silhouette and readable architectural identity at zoom 12/9; current 49.8K gate remains a validation default, not a mandatory final budget
primary.material_policy: canonical material families plus bounded asset-specific masks/accents
primary.lod_policy: evaluate after visual formula is stable and mobile profiling exists

hero.purpose: Bastion, monumental ruins and bounded hero fragments
hero.geometry_policy: prioritize macro silhouette and hero identity; triangle budget must be justified by official-camera evidence and target-device profiling
hero.material_policy: canonical families with higher-quality masks/bakes/accents, never a disconnected shading model
hero.lod_policy: expected candidate once target-device profiling is available

promotion_rule: No numeric production triangle budget becomes canonical solely by guesswork; compare official-camera quality and target-mobile performance first.
